chunks: Announce the Pilgrimage to the people. They will come to you on foot and riding along distant roads on lean and slender beasts,
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about how people will travel for Hajj?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as the divine proclamation (Nadba) of Hajj, highlighting the universality of the pilgrimage and the physical exertion of the believers. The mention of 'lean camels' (Dhumar) is seen as a sign of divine provision, ensuring that even those with limited means can fulfill this pillar, reflecting the accessibility of worship in Islamic tradition.
